headline: Anthropic Claude Duet Challenges Proprietary AI Agents
summary: Anthropic has launched Claude Duet, an always-on AI agent that operates independently of user input, competing with leading commercial models from Meta and OpenAI. This move is reshaping the landscape of AI agent deployment and accessibility.
whyItMatters: It democratizes AI agent capabilities, potentially reducing reliance on proprietary systems and lowering barriers to entry for developers and businesses.
